paragraphs.text: Jenges is a city in the nation of Wrenna , located on the east shore of North Aerona , on the plane of Dominaria . Jenges is located on the shore of the Sea of Whales .

Before c. 3500 AR , Jenges was the home of the Knights of Jenges , but a terrible mage seized the throne of Jenges. This caused Torsten Von Ursus , one of the nation's knights, to leave the Order and the realm and journey southwestwards, where he eventually founded Benalia in the fading capital of Sheoltun .

In 4074 AR, Terrill from Wrenna belonged to the Black Knights of Jenges before he joined Gull 's army of wizard-hunters. This indicates that the order of knights from Jenges still held, although now specifically only hosting black knights .
